newsitem.title: USA: Texas spot electricity steady through to Monday.
newsitem.headline: Texas spot electricity steady through to Monday.

text.p: Wholesale electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) held steady through the weekend, with very few traders doing business Friday, industry sources said.
Temperatures through Texas were expected to be relatively cool Friday, with highs forecast in the 40s and 50s degrees Fahrenheit range.
Over the longer term, temperatures in south Texas were forecast to be normal and in north Texas below normal from December 3 to December 7.
ERCOT firm, peak power for Monday delivery was notionally pegged steady at $29.00-31.00, with almost all traders having sewn op their Monday business on Wednesday.
Off-peak non-firm ERCOT power transactions were pegged steady at $16.00-18.00, the sources said.
ERCOT December peak power was notionally said to be talked steady at $31.00-33.00, while January/February peak power was steady at $31.50-32.00, the sources said.
